title.en: Pool and timber footbridge from above

alt.tr: Yukarıdan görülen, kıvrımlı ahşap deck ile çevrili havuz ve üzerindeki kemerli köprü
alt.en: View from above of a pool edged with curved wooden decking and an arched footbridge

caption.tr: Yukarıdan bakınca havuzun kıvrımlı hattını izleyen deck ve köprünün kemeri net görünüyor.
caption.en: From above, the deck following the curved outline of the pool and the arch of the bridge are easy to see.
